name: SpotlightCard-TS-TW

frames.best_why: A soft white spotlight is clearly visible on the left card with the cursor clear of its text.

tagline: A soft pool of light trails the pointer across each dark card.
summary: A pair of rounded dark cards that stay flat until the pointer moves over them, then a colourless or tinted radial glow follows the cursor across the surface and fades when it leaves.
appearance: Two rounded charcoal cards sit side by side on a black stage, each with a thin lighter border. Inside, a bold white heading and a few lines of grey body text are aligned top-left, leaving the lower half empty. When lit, a soft circular patch of light washes one area of the card.
behaviour: Moving the pointer over a card places a radial spotlight directly under it and raises its opacity; leaving fades it out over half a second. Otherwise the cards stay flat and still.
demo_content: Two cards headed 'White spotlight' and 'Purple spotlight', with lines about moving the cursor and a customisable colour.
search_phrases: dark card with a light that follows the mouse
cursor following light effect on a panel
hover glow that tracks the pointer
mouse following light on a dark tile
light that fades when the pointer leaves
soft light spot on a feature card
use_when: You want a dark feature or pricing card that rewards a hover with a subtle moving light, without extra assets.
avoid_when: The light is pointer-only, so touch gets a flat card, and the effect barely shows on light backgrounds.
customise: Children fill the card and spotlightColor sets the glow as an rgba string; width and spacing come from your own classes. Radius, padding, border and the dark surface are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Two divs and a mouse-driven gradient; no animation loop runs while the pointer is still.

a11y.note: The spotlight is pointer-only and the card cannot take focus, so keyboard and touch users never trigger it.

issues: The card wires focus handlers but has no tabIndex, so its focus state can never fire.
The dim grey body copy is low contrast against the dark card.
The glow only works for a mouse and disappears entirely without a pointer.
polish_why: Tidy dark cards and a gentle glow, but the effect is faint and the demo is plain.
title: Spotlight Card
